title: Grand Inaugural Concert
description: Raaga Sudha Sabha opened its first season with a full-length kutcheri by Sri Abhishek Raghuram, accompanied by a formidable ensemble. A packed Lakireddy Hall heard an expansive Todi and a Ragam-Tanam-Pallavi that ran well past the scheduled hour.
